_about: SHELF of Jules Michelet in English before 1931, each title gated on its own translator: G. H. Smith's History of France, C. Cocks's Historical View of the French Revolution, The People and Priests, Women, and Families, Hazlitt's Life of Luther, J. W. Palmer's Woman, W. H. Davenport Adams's The Insect and The Sea, Calfa's Bible of Humanity and M. C. M. Simpson's Summary of Modern History. Trotter's La Sorcière is on singles-ideas. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 99); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. 'smith', 'cocks', 'adams' and 'palmer' alone are left out as common words.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.

mic-history-of-france-vol-2.author: The title page OCR reads 'TRANSLATED BV G, H, SMITH, F, G, S,' for G. H. Smith, F.G.S., over a New York (Appleton) imprint. Checked by eye 2026-10-17.
